flows.title: App routing: /web basename, area code-splitting, initial-route preload
Session spine: compat handshake, session renewal, identity epoch, request guard
Server event stream (/api/events) with reconnect backoff
Service worker registration and reload-on-controller-change
Native app-store host bridge: host messages, open in native player
App shell chrome: header, library sidebar, account menu, phone layout
Shell and per-area error boundaries with reload panel
Server activity indicator (running jobs and rescans) in the shell
Rescan a library or all libraries and follow scan state
Localization: locale resolution, ICU formatting and string catalogs
Shared workbench widgets: status chips, tables, forms, server path picker
UI primitives: button, dialog, alert dialog, select, table, tabs, tree and form controls
GraphQL client wire types shared by every data call
Display helpers: activity, job, provider-key and string formatting
First-run setup wizard shell: token intake, step navigation
Setup: choose sign-in security mode and create the owner Profile
Setup: activate plugins and enter provider keys
Setup: pick a library type and folder, create the first Library and scan
Setup: configure the update-check channel
Enroll a browser with a pairing code
Home-mode admin password sign-in on the enroll page
Admin Session unlock gate (admin password) reused by Console
Promote an enrolled browser to a manager device
Sign out of the web session
